comment: The panel as captured on 17 October 2026 (docs/CABINET_CONTROLS.md, docs/data/panel-capture-*.json). Codes are Linux evdev button codes; an SDL, RetroArch or MAME button number is the code minus 288. Axes: abs 0 is X, abs 1 is Y; a sign is the direction of the reading (negative: left or up on a standard stick). Both players are the same encoder model; they differ only by USB port.

layout.comment: What each physical control means to a game. BUTTON_1..6 are the arcade action buttons in this order; the flight stick's trigger and secondary also act as Player 2's BUTTON_1 and BUTTON_2.
